blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Large language models (LLMs) often diagnose full sight, static clinical cases well yet struggle in foresight, dynamic diagnosis. Prior work has improved this limitation by quantifying the information models acquire and by developing stronger follow-up strategies to improve diagnostic accuracy. In contrast, we introduce a distinctive hindsight to systematically dissect why LLMs fail to acquire diagnostically critical evidence, tracing the failure from evidence identification, utilization and downstream diagnostic updating through not only diagnostic accuracy, but also evidence coverage, trajectory dynamics, and elicited probability and information entropy. Starting experiments from the breakdown at the level of capabilities, to the diagnosis of the pre-event state before the evidence arrives, and to the post-event state transition after the evidence arrives, our research has revealed the profound limitations and internal causes existing in the dynamic diagnostic process. At the same time, we have also conducted sufficient verification and generalization experiments to prove that these limitations are widespread. Together, these findings shift the central challenge from whether LLMs possess relevant clinical knowledge to whether they can identify, acquire, and effectively use the right evidence under clinical diagnosis and conduct a more detailed mechanism analysis to identify the exact location of the capability gap.
blocks.zh: 大型语言模型(LLMS)经常诊断出全视,静态临床病例很好,但在前瞻,动态诊断中却挣扎. 先前的工作通过量化所获得的信息模型并制订更强有力的后续战略来提高诊断准确性,从而改进了这一局限性。 相比之下,我们引入了一种独特的后视力,系统地解析LLMS为何未能获得诊断性的关键证据,通过不仅诊断准确性,而且证据覆盖面,轨迹动态,以及引出概率和信息等手段追踪证据识别、利用和下游诊断更新的失败。 从能力水平的分解开始实验,到证据到来之前对事前状态的诊断,再到证据到来之后的事后状态过渡,我们的研究揭示了动态诊断过程中存在的深刻局限性和内在原因. 同时,我们还进行了充分的核查和概括试验,以证明这些限制是普遍的。 这些结论共同将中心挑战从LLMS是否拥有相关的临床知识转移到它们是否能够识别,获取并有效利用临床诊断中正确的证据,并进行更详尽的机制分析,以确定能力差距的确切位置.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Large language models (LLMs) can answer many medical questions, make clinical judgments, and achieve very high diagnostic accuracy when complete clinical evidence is presented upfront ( Singhal et al., 2023 ; Singhal et al., 2025 ; Arora et al., 2025 ) . However, such strong performance on static, information-complete tasks does not reliably translate to realistic clinical capabilities, where LLMs still exhibit substantial performance degradation when they must interact with patients, actively acquire missing evidence, and reason through sequential diagnostic processes ( Bean et al., 2026 ; Chen et al., 2026b ; Li et al., 2024 ; Johri et al., 2025 ; Tu et al., 2025 ) . This gap has motivated the development of dynamic and interactive diagnostic benchmarks, as conventional static question-answering benchmarks cannot adequately capture the iterative evidence acquisition and sequential decision-making required in real-world clinical diagnosis ( Schmidgall et al., 2026 ; Chen et al., 2026b ) .
Besides, EviMed and related evidence-centered work measure whether relevant or sufficient information is covered; expected-information and evidence-gap methods propose better targets or policies ( Long and Wei, 2026 ; Huang et al., 2026 ; Wong et al., 2026 ; Sanghvi et al., 2026 ; Dai et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh:
大语言模型(LLMS)可以回答许多医学问题,做出临床判断,并在提出完整的临床证据前实现非常高的诊断精度(Singhal等,2023;Singhal等,2025;Arora等,2025.). 然而,静态、信息完成任务的这种强效表现并不能可靠地转化为现实的临床能力,在这种能力中,LLMs在必须与病人互动时仍然表现出显著的性能退化,通过相继诊断过程积极获取缺失的证据和理性(Bean等,2026;Chen等,2026b;Li等,2024;Johri等,2025;Tu等,2025.). 这一差距推动了动态和互动诊断基准的制定,因为传统的静态问答基准无法充分抓住现实世界临床诊断所需的迭接证据获取和相继决策(Schmidgall等,2026;Chen等,2026b.).
此外,EviMed和相关以证据为核心的工作计量是否涵盖相关信息或充足信息;预期信息和证据差距方法提出了更好的目标或政策(Long and Wei, 2026;Huang等人, 2026;Wong等人, 2026;Sanghvi等人, 2026;Dai等人, 2026)。

blocks.en: To bridge this capability gap, several recent studies have explored methods to improve follow-up questioning and progressive evidence acquisition. FollowupQ uses a multi-agent framework to generate personalized follow-up questions by jointly leveraging patient messages and longitudinal EHR context ( Gatto et al., 2025 ) . KG-Followup incorporates structured medical knowledge graphs to guide the identification of missing clinical information and generate more comprehensive questions ( Sun et al., 2026 ) . DDO formulates symptom inquiry and diagnosis as separate but collaborative decision processes, explicitly optimizing sequential information acquisition ( Jia et al., 2025 ) . Doctor-R1 uses agentic reinforcement learning to learn high-yield inquiry strategies over multi-turn clinical interactions ( Lai et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: 为了弥补这一能力差距,最近的一些研究探讨了改进后续询问和逐步获取证据的方法。 后续行动 Q使用多剂框架,通过联合利用病人的信息和纵向EHR背景,生成个性化的后续问题(Gatto等,2025年)。 KG-后续包含了结构化的医学知识图来指导识别缺失的临床信息并产生更全面的问题(Sun等,2026). DDO将症状调查和诊断作为单独但合作的决策过程,明确优化顺序信息获取(Jia等,2025年)。 Doctor-R1利用剂性强化学习,在多回合临床互动中学习高产探究策略(Lai等,2026年).

blocks.en: Benchmarks and studies show that prospective acquisition is difficult and that stronger evidence collection can help, but they do not jointly trace the behavioral mechanism from an attempted action to the evidence actually obtained and then to diagnosis. Rather than treating this gap as a surface performance deficit, we seek to dissect the underlying behavioral process and identify where and why prospective evidence acquisition breaks down. Our key question is therefore narrower and deeper: what specifically limits LLMs’ prospective evidence acquisition, which factors most strongly shape these limitations, and what underlying mechanisms give rise to them?
blocks.zh: 基准和研究表明,预期的获取是困难的,更强有力的证据收集可以有所帮助,但是它们并没有共同追踪行为机制从企图行动到实际获得的证据再到诊断. 我们不是将这一差距视为表面性能不足,而是试图解析基本的行为过程,并查明证据获取在何处和为何会中断。 因此,我们的关键问题是狭窄和更深层:什么具体限制了LLMs的预期证据获取,哪些因素最有力地决定了这些限制,以及产生这些限制的基本机制是什么?

blocks.en: Most existing static evaluations contrast complete-information disclosure once, what we call Fullsight , with prospective interactive diagnosis what we call Foresight that models perform well when all evidence is available upfront. MedAction analyzes multi-turn diagnosis and identifies ungrounded test ordering, unreliable diagnostic updating, and degraded conversational coherence as recurring failures ( Hsu et al., 2026 ) . CDEG compares successful and failed diagnostic trajectories to identify decision-critical evidence, then tests its effect through controlled interventions ( Dai et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: 大多数现有的静态评价 对比了一次完整的信息披露, 我们称之为"Fullsight"(Fullsight), 与我们称之为"展望"(Foresight)的预期互动诊断, 当所有证据都可用时,模型表现良好。 MedAction分析多回合诊断,并确定无根据的测试订单,不可靠的诊断更新,以及退化的谈话一致性为反复出现的失败(Hsu等,2026). CDEG比较成功和失败的诊断轨迹,以确定决定关键的证据,然后通过控制性干预测试其效果(Dai等,2026年).

blocks.en:
However, this contrast alone cannot show whether models can recognize useful evidence once a case is complete, or where that evidence is lost during a step-by-step consultation. We introduce Hindsight as a retrospective perspective: after seeing the fully realized case, the model identifies the facts most useful for diagnosis. This reveals something Fullsight accuracy cannot show on its own that a model may recognize useful evidence after seeing its result but fail to seek it actively and priority while the result is unknown. We first observe this pattern across ten completed models shown in Figure 1 . We then compare Hindsight and Foresight at each disclosure depth, tracing what the model asks, what evidence it obtains, and how its diagnosis changes.

The second difference motivates our deeper analysis of clinical evidence acquisition ability gap in interactive diagnosis.

Our contributions are: (1) We introduce hindsight as a new perspective to examine evidence recognition in interactive diagnosis that LLMs often fail to find those facts. Fullsight demonstrates LLMs do not lack medical knowledge and hindsight proves evidence recognition ability in LLMs and provides a reference for the cognitive ability limit which reveals a gap between recognizing useful evidence afterward and acquiring it while the outcome is still unknown; (2) We examine this gap throughout the foresight trajectory. At each step, we track what the model asks, what new evidence it actually obtains, and how its diagnosis changes. Comparing these trajectories with the useful facts identified in hindsight lets us distinguish problems that arise before evidence arrives from problems that persist after it arrives. Controlled evidence additions then test whether a missed fact can change the diagnosis; (3) We test the findings from multiple facets. Comparisons of question formats, fact counts, evidence order, and diagnostic history help rule out simple explanations for the gap. Further tests across models and datasets examine how broadly the pattern holds and prove the prevalence of the conclusions drawn from our research.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Recent benchmarks have moved beyond static medical QA toward interactive and sequential diagnosis. MediQ, CRAFT-MD, and AMIE evaluate adaptive questioning and simulated diagnostic conversations ( Li et al., 2024 ; Johri et al., 2025 ; Tu et al., 2025 ) ; AgentClinic, AI Hospital, and MedAgentBench provide simulated clinical or EHR environments ( Schmidgall et al., 2026 ; Fan et al., 2025 ; Jiang et al., 2025 ) . MedR-Bench, Q4Dx, MINT, DiagnosisArena, RareArena, and CPC-Bench further extend evaluation to test selection, sequential revision, and broader diagnostic reasoning ( Qiu et al., 2025 ; Werthaim et al., 2026 ; Fang et al., 2026 ; Zhu et al., 2026 ; Chen et al., 2026a ; Buckley et al., 2025 ) .
blocks.zh: 最近的基准已经超越了静态医疗质量评估,转向互动和相继诊断。 MediQ、CRAFT-MD和AMIE评价适应性的询问和模拟诊断谈话(Li等,2024;Johri等,2025;Tu等,2025;AgentClinic、AI医院和MedAgent Bench提供模拟临床或EHR环境(Schmidgall等,2026;Fan等,2025;Jiang等,2025;MedR-Bench、Q4Dx、MINT、Diagnosarena、Rarearena和CPT-Bench进一步扩展评价范围,以测试选择、顺序修订和更广泛的诊断推理(Quu等,2025;Werthaim等,2026;Fang等,2026;Zhu等,2026;Chen等,2026a;Buckley等,2025)。

blocks.en: A growing line of work improves how models decide what information to acquire next and how the acquired evidence shapes their judgments. EviMed and MT-InfoSeek explicitly model missing or sufficient evidence ( Long and Wei, 2026 ; Huang et al., 2026 ) ; MedClarify, MeDxAgent, and CDEG prioritize diagnostically informative or decision-critical evidence ( Wong et al., 2026 ; Sanghvi et al., 2026 ; Dai et al., 2026 ) . Sequential Diagnosis and Doctor-R1 instead learn cost-aware or adaptive inquiry policies over multi-turn interactions ( Nori et al., 2025 ; Lai et al., 2025 ) . Evidence-auditing studies examine output changes under controlled evidence subsets ( Liao et al., 2026 ) , information-based approaches analyze how particular evidence shifts diagnostic uncertainty, and hindsight studies show that access to outcome or future information can alter subsequent judgments ( Fischhoff, 1975 ; Matsuura et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: 越来越多的工作改善了模型如何决定下一步要获得哪些信息,以及获得的证据如何影响其判断。 EviMed和MT-InfoSeek明确模拟缺失或充分证据(Long and Wei, 2026;Huang等人, 2026;MedClarify, MeDxAgent, 和CDEG) 优先提供诊断性或决定性证据(Wong等人, 2026;Sanghvi等人, 2026;Dai等人, 2026;Sequentical Disagnosis and Doctor-R1 转而学习关于多回合相互作用的成本认识或适应性调查政策(Nori等人, 2025;Lai等人, 2025)。 证据-审计研究在被控制的证据子集(Liao等,2026年)下审查产出变化,以信息为基础的方法分析特定证据如何转移诊断不确定性,事后研究表明获取结果或未来信息可以改变后续判断(Fischhoff,1975年;松浦等,2026年).

blocks.en: 3 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 3 实验设置

blocks.en: 3.1 Experimental Design
blocks.zh: 3.1 实验设计

blocks.en:
Figure 2 organizes the study from the visible performance gap to the stages at which it arises. We first establish the contrast among fullsight diagnosis, foresight acquisition, and hindsight retrospective evidence identification (A). Results in Figure 1 reveal the phenomenon. Then, we delved deeper into the phenomenon, and thoroughly analyzed where the gap in evidence acquisition lies.
We divide evidence acquisition into three steps.
First, before a result is known (B), we distinguish requests from newly obtained evidence, compare free-form requests with a result-blind menu, and examine adaptation after no-match and duplication actions. Second, for the evidence actually acquired (C), we match evidence counts case by case, separate evidence-set effects from order effects, and test whether diagnostically critical facts are reached. Third, after evidence arrives (D), we track diagnostic transitions, intervene with a retrospectively identified fact, and test the entropy presentation, diagnostic distribution and how prior context history affect the response.
The final part E includes validation experiments for recurrence, ablation, and robustness.
blocks.zh:
图2将研究从明显的性能差距组织到其产生阶段。 我们首先在全面诊断、前瞻获取和事后追溯证据鉴定(A)之间建立了对比。 图1显示这一现象。 然后,我们更深入地探索这个现象, 并彻底分析证据获取的空白之处。
我们把证据收集分为三个步骤。
首先,在知道结果(B)之前,我们将请求与新获得的证据区分开来,将自由格式的请求与结果盲菜单相提并论,并在不匹配和重复动作后审查适应性. 第二,对于实际获得的证据(C),我们逐个将证据计数,将证据设定效应与命令效应区分开来,并检验判断关键事实是否达到. 第三,在证据到达(D)后,我们追踪诊断的过渡,以追溯识别的事实进行干预,并测试肽的呈现,诊断分布以及先前的背景历史如何影响反应.
E部分的最后部分包括重复性、衰竭性和坚固性的验证实验。

blocks.en: 3.2 Datasets and Cohorts.
blocks.zh: 3.2 数据集和目录。

blocks.en: The frozen source universe contains 320 cases: 140 AgentClinic MedQA cases, 80 dermatology cases, and 100 DiagnosisArena cases. Thus the primary estimand is conditional on complete-case competence, not population-level clinical accuracy. Prespecified derived cohorts are the result-blind menu cohort ( N = 120 N=120 ), evidence-set/order cohort ( N = 100 N=100 ), selector-robustness cohort ( N = 100 N=100 ), four-model shared cohort ( N = 59 N=59 ), shared menu cohort ( N = 50 N=50 ), and balanced EviMed bridge ( N = 200 N=200 ). The generated cohort-flow file records every case ID.

blocks.en: 3.3 Models and Configuration.
blocks.zh: 3.3 模型和配置。

blocks.en: Initial experiment completed 10 general LLMs, yielding 798 eligible model–case pairs. The strict study uses GPT-5.5 and separates four roles: a selector proposes evidence targets, the environment matcher realizes at most one canonical fact, a fresh diagnostic call reads each evidence prefix, and a diagnosis-equivalence judge scores the output. The shared replications additionally use DeepSeek V3.2, Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview, and GLM 5.2. We use OpenRouter as API service, temperature 0, provider-default top- p p , maximum outputs of 3,500 tokens by stage, and at most three transport retries.
blocks.zh: 初步实验完成了10个普通LLM,产生了798个合格的型号-案例对. 严格的研究使用GPT-5.5,并分离出四个角色:一个选取者提出证据目标,环境匹配者在最多一个犬科的事实中意识到,一个新的诊断呼叫读取了每个证据前缀,一个诊断-等效判断者评分输出. 共享复制还额外使用了DeepSeek V3.2,双子座3.1 Pro Preview,和GLM 5.2. 我们使用OpenRouter作为API服务,温度0,提供者-默认顶-pp,最大输出3500个令牌,最多三次运输回放.

blocks.en: 3.4 Metrics
blocks.zh: 3.4 计量

blocks.en: Common metrics include Diagnostic Accuracy, Evidence Yield, Critical-Evidence Reach, Stable Sufficiency, Wrong-State Persistence, and Information Coverage Rate. Individual experiments use additional task-specific metrics. Owing to space constraints, all metric definitions, formulas, and denominators are provided in Appendix.

blocks.en: 4 Results and Analysis
blocks.zh: 4 结果和分析

blocks.en: 4.1 A. Ability Gap
blocks.zh: 4.1 A. 能力差距

blocks.en: 4.1.1 A.1 Phenomenon disclosure
blocks.zh: 4.1.1 A.1 现象披露

blocks.en: Experiments across 10 general LLMs shown in figure 1 reveal a V-shaped diagnostic accuracy curve in fullsight–foresight–hindsight trajectory. It is clear that LLMs do not lack knowledge, and they have sufficient ability to review and identify relevant evidence, and can select and prioritize the most diagnostically valuable evidence from the full evidence set which is an upper limit that a model can potentially reach under comprehensive consideration. Obviously, there are still limitations in the ability to acquire evidence in foresight, which have not yet reached the upper limit.
blocks.zh: 图1显示的10个普通LLMs的实验显示一个V形诊断精度曲线在全视-前视-实景轨迹中. 显然,法学硕士并不缺乏知识,他们有足够的能力审查和确定相关证据,并且能够从整套证据中挑选和优先排列最有诊断价值的证据,这是模型在综合审议中可能达到的上限。 显然,在获得前瞻性证据的能力方面仍然存在一些限制,这些限制尚未达到上限。

blocks.en: 4.1.2 A.2 Critical Evidence
blocks.zh: 4.1.2 A.2 关键证据

blocks.en:
Foresight’s poor performance cannot simply be attributed to an inability to diagnose the disease. We examine this gap in the primary cohort ( N = 181 N=181 ) and a separate 12-step continuation cohort ( N = 140 N=140 ; Table 1 ). At k = 3 k=3 , Foresight reached 33.1% accuracy, whereas hindsight reached 73.5%, yielding a paired gap of 40.3 percentage points (95% CI 32.6–48.6).
To assess the direction and consistency of the paired difference, we report the matched-pair odds ratio and the two-sided exact McNemar p p -value, both calculated from cases in which only one condition produced the correct diagnosis. At k = 3 k=3 , discordant outcomes strongly favored Hindsight over Foresight (OR = 15.60 =15.60 , p = 6.40 × 10 − 18 p=6.40\times 10^{-18} ). Extending the original policy to twelve requests improved Foresight to 52.5%, but Hindsight remained higher at 77.3%, leaving a 24.9-point gap (95% CI 17.1–32.0; OR = 7.43 =7.43 , p = 1.36 × 10 − 9 p=1.36\times 10^{-9} ). The continuation cohort showed the same pattern, demonstrating that the recognition advantage remained directionally consistent even under a larger acquisition budget. Thus, hindsight identifies realized evidence that supports correct diagnosis substantially more often than the evidence acquired prospectively.
blocks.zh:
前瞻的不良表现不能简单地归因于无法诊断出这种疾病。 我们在初级组别(N = 181 N = 181)和单独的12步连续组别(N = 140 N = 140;表1)中检查这一差距。 在k = 3 k = 3 时,前瞻达到33.1%的精度,而后瞻达到73.5%,对接差距为40.3个百分点(95% CI 32.6–48.6)。
为了评估配对差异的方向和一致性,我们报告配对-派比和双侧精确的McNemar p-value,两者都是根据只有一个病症产生正确诊断的病例来计算的. K = 3 k = 3, 偏好偏差结果大于前视(OR = 15.60 = 15.60, p = 6.40 × 10 – 18 p = 6.40\times 10\times 18\times 10\times 10\times 18} ) , 将原有政策扩展至12项改进前视到52.5%,但后视仍然较高,为77.3%, 留下了24.9分的差距(95% CI 17.1–32.0; OR = 7.43 = 7.43, p = 1.36 × 10 – 9 p= 1.36\times 10\times 9} ) 。 续编组显示了同样的模式,表明即使在较大的购置预算下,识别优势仍然方向一致。 因此,事后发现,与预期获得的证据相比,更经常地发现支持正确诊断的已实现证据。

blocks.en: We therefore use hindsight as a plausible empirical upper reference for the remainder of the analysis. It is not an existing clinical acquisition method, a deployable policy, or a formal global optimum. Rather, it asks what diagnostic trajectory the same LLM can retrospectively construct from its own medical knowledge once the complete realized case is visible, while withholding the reference diagnosis. In this sense, hindsight approximates the upper envelope of evidence recognition available to the model when uncertainty about which observations will be realized has been removed.
blocks.zh: 因此,我们把事后观察作为分析其余部分的可信的经验参考。 这不是现有的临床获取方法、可部署政策或正式的全球最佳办法。 相反,它询问,一旦完全实现的病例明显可见,同样的LLM从自己的医学知识中可以追溯构造出什么样的诊断轨迹,同时不进行参考诊断。 从这个意义上讲,事后看来,模型在排除了对哪些观测结果的不确定性时,可以使用的证据识别的上层封套是大致的。

blocks.en: Section 4.3 showed that foresight often acquires evidence with lower diagnostic value. We now ask what happens after evidence enters the case state that whether the diagnostic distribution changes, and whether a missed high-value fact can reverse an incorrect diagnosis.
blocks.zh: 第4.3节显示,展望往往获得诊断价值较低的证据。 我们现在问,在证据进入案件之后会发生什么情况,即诊断分布是否发生变化,一个被忽略的高价值事实是否能够逆转一个错误的诊断。

blocks.en: 4.4.1 D.1 Diagnostic-state updating
blocks.zh: 4.4.1 D.1 最新诊断状态

blocks.en:
Figure 6 follows the same 181 cases across four three-step intervals. Under hindsight, most updating occurs in the first interval which is from k = 0 k=0 to k = 3 k=3 , the mean probability assigned to the reference diagnosis increases by 0.298, while diagnostic entropy changes by − 0.439 -0.439 bits. Later hindsight intervals show little additional change. Foresight increases the reference-diagnosis probability more gradually through k = 9 k=9 , but none of its entropy changes is clearly different from zero; from k = 9 k=9 to k = 12 k=12 , it shows no reliable additional gain.
Thus, retrospectively prioritized evidence produces an early, concentrated diagnostic update, whereas prospectively acquired evidence yields slower and less consistent concentration. Together, these fixed-support probability distributions and entropy measures provide a behavioral proxy for how the model’s implicit diagnostic state changes as evidence accumulates.

因此,追溯性优先的证据可以产生早期、集中的诊断更新,而预期获得的证据则产生较慢和较不一致的集中。 这些固定支持概率分布和等效度量法共同为模型的隐含诊断状态如何随着证据积累而变化提供了一个行为代名词.

blocks.en:
The trajectory results alone cannot show whether a missed fact caused diagnostic failure. We therefore intervene on incorrect Foresight states by adding either an unseen hindsight ranked fact or a pre-frozen matched-control fact from the same case. In the prespecified complete-grid cohort, the mean critical-minus-control rescue is + 38.8 +38.8 percentage points for hindsight Rank 1, + 24.8 +24.8 for Rank 2, and + 10.3 +10.3 for Rank 3. The Rank-1-minus-Rank-3 contrast is + 28.5 +28.5 points. By contrast, the Rank-1 difference between insertion at k = 1 k=1 and k = 12 k=12 is not clearly supported.
These results show that omission of high-value evidence can directly contribute to diagnostic failure. Rescue depends more clearly on evidence rank than on the measured insertion depth. The all-eligible analysis is reported in the appendix: its critical-minus-control effect is positive in all 15 rank–depth cells, but its changing denominators do not permit a fixed-cohort comparison of insertion timing.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion

blocks.en:
Our work reframes the gap between static and interactive diagnosis as a
failure to translate recognized evidence value into prospective action.
Fullsight establishes that the model can solve the completed case, while
hindsight shows that, once the case is realized, the same model can identify a compact and diagnostically useful trajectory without access to the reference diagnosis. The persistent separation from foresight therefore cannot be reduced to missing disease knowledge. Our stage-wise analysis localizes the loss: (1) before evidence arrives, requests do not reliably obtain novel facts, and it is hard to recover from previous failure; (2) among the facts obtained, identity and order matter beyond quantity, while distributional change or increased confidence
does not guarantee diagnostic truth-directed progress; (3) after evidence arrives, high-value facts can produce earlier updates and directly rescue incorrect diagnoses. Recurrence across model backbones and data sources supports a multi-stage evidence acquisition bottleneck.

Fullsight确定模型可以解决完成的案件,同时
事后的观察表明,一旦病例实现,同一种模型可以识别出紧凑而诊断有用的轨迹,而无需查阅参考诊断. 因此,不能把长期与远见分离的现象降低为对疾病缺乏了解。 我们的分阶段分析将损失定位:(1) 在证据到达之前,请求无法可靠地获得新的事实,而且很难从先前的失败中恢复;(2) 在获得的事实中,身份和命令的重要性超出数量,同时分配变化或增强信心。

blocks.en:
Hindsight is neither a deployable acquisition policy nor evidence that the
entire retrospective gap is avoidable. It is an empirical reference that
reveals what the model’s existing knowledge can support once uncertainty
about evidence realization is removed, and our conclusions remain
conditional on complete-case competence and controlled evidence
environments. The next challenge is to convert this retrospective recognition
into prospective control under the information available at decision time.
Future clinical follow-up should jointly optimize target realizability, novelty, diagnostic value, sequencing, and failure-specific recovery, while being evaluated across the full chain from request to realized evidence to
diagnostic transition. Closing the gap from hindsight to foresight therefore
means turning available medical knowledge into timely, reliable
evidence-seeking behavior.

internal belief. For each case, a fixed support of 8–12 diagnosis candidates

labels and available clinical evidence, but not the reference indicator. It
must assign nonnegative mass to every fixed candidate ID; raw sums must be
within 0.01 0.01 of one, and invalid vectors are not arbitrarily normalized.
The support is fixed for each case before the compared readouts.

blocks.en:
This appendix expands Experiment C in the order of the main text. The unit of
analysis is the fact actually returned by an action, rather than the
request alone. The diagnosis-unconditioned Hindsight selector sees the
completed case and ranks its non-initial atomic facts, but receives neither the
reference diagnosis nor the prospective trajectory. It is consequently a
retrospective reference for evidence identity and ordering, not a policy that
could be deployed at the prospective decision point. The primary paired
cohort contains 181 Fullsight-correct, protocol-complete cases; the six-action
order intervention uses a fixed subset of 100 cases (61 AgentClinic MedQA, 19
dermatology, 20 DiagnosisArena). The 140-case count-matched continuation is
another fixed subset of the primary cohort. These denominators are kept
separate throughout.

blocks.en:
The acquisition call asks the clinical policy, using only the initial
presentation, acquired facts, and previous request outcomes, to choose one
free-text clinical information request and a request type. It cannot see
hidden fact IDs or diagnosis labels. The environment matcher returns at most
one new atomic fact per action, or records duplicate or no_match . The Hindsight selector is instructed to “rank exactly six”
non-initial facts by diagnostic usefulness, to use only supplied IDs once, and
is explicitly told that the gold diagnosis, Fullsight diagnosis, and Foresight
trajectory are unavailable. The same-set reranker instead receives all
and only the facts Foresight actually acquired and must use every supplied ID
exactly once. Fresh diagnostic probes receive just the initial presentation
and the evidence prefix; their JSON output contains a top diagnosis and up to
five ordered differential diagnoses. The C1 acquisition,
ranking, and probe calls used deepseek/deepseek-v3.2 through OpenRouter
at temperature zero, with a six-action cap. Case/order randomization is
seeded in the frozen run configuration; the provider did not expose a
deterministic generation seed. Diagnostic correctness uses normalized exact
matching followed where needed by a blinded independent GPT-5.5 judge; uncertain is scored incorrect. C1 intervals use paired case-level
percentile bootstraps (5,000 draws), rather than independent provider-call
resampling.

blocks.en: The 181 181 primary cases have five adjacent transitions across six diagnostic prefixes. Each transition is wrong-to-wrong (WW), wrong-to-correct (WC), correct-to-correct (CC), or correct-to-wrong (CW), using independent diagnosis-equivalence grades. Table 17 reports all event denominators. Of 630 transitions beginning wrong, 572 remain wrong (90.8%); 259/275 transitions beginning correct stay correct (94.2%). Wrong-state persistence is 272/330 when a new fact arrives and 300/300 when the next action is stagnant. New evidence is therefore necessary for a correct transition in these observed rows, but is not sufficient. In 95/181 cases (52.5%), all diagnoses at k = 1 , … , 6 k=1,\ldots,6 are wrong. The case-mean action-stagnation rate is 41.3%; next-action recovery after a duplicate or no-match is 134/343 (39.1%).

blocks.en: Clinical case study: D.2: Chronic cough and rank-dependent rescue Case agentclinic_medqa_151 is a 50-year-old man with two months of cough; the reference diagnosis is Valley fever. Hindsight Rank 1 is pathology describing necrotizing granulomas with spherules and endospores (E5); Rank 2 is hiking near Phoenix (P11); Rank 3 is positive PAS/silver staining (E10). The unaugmented repeat predicts upper airway cough syndrome and is incorrect at all five depths. Appending E5 yields coccidioidomycosis and is correct in 5/5 probes; appending P11 is also correct in 5/5; E10 instead leads to an incorrect Pneumocystis diagnosis in 5/5. blocks.en: F.1 Selector repeatability and downstream sensitivity

blocks.en: The primary Hindsight selector sees the complete realized non-initial fact pool but neither the reference diagnosis nor Fullsight output. The selector audit freezes 100 cases, makes three independent repeats, two fact-order permutations, and one prompt paraphrase, and separately tests GPT-5.5 and Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview as alternative selectors on 80 cases. In the three-repeat pairwise distribution, mean Top-1 agreement is 83.7%, Top-3 Jaccard is 0.789, and rank-biased overlap at six is 0.862. The selector is therefore not deterministic at the fact level. Table 26 reports each variant’s agreement and downstream Hindsight@3 diagnostic accuracy; positive retrospective utility survives the tested perturbations, while exact ranks vary.

blocks.en: The candidate pool, IDs, diagnostic probe, and clinical label are held fixed while the ranking call changes. The first two facts in a perturbed ranking may differ from the primary ranking, so this is a sensitivity test of the claim, not evidence of a unique ground-truth evidence order.

blocks.en: F.2 Shared-case model and source recurrence
blocks.zh: F.2 共同案件模式和源重现

blocks.en: The paired four-model replication uses the identical 59 eligible cases for DeepSeek V3.2, GPT-5.5, Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview, and GLM 5.2. The acquisition/diagnosis roles use the model assigned to each condition; the diagnosis-equivalence judge is separate. The gap is positive in all four point estimates. Gemini’s 95% interval includes zero, so this is directional recurrence, not a claim that every backbone has a statistically resolved gap.
blocks.zh: 配对的"四型相仿"采用完全相同的59个合格案例,分别用于DeepSeek V3.2,GPT-5.5,双子座3.1 Pro Preview,和GLM 5.2. 获取/诊断角色使用分配给每个病情的模型;诊断-等效裁判是分开的. 在所有四点估计中,差距是正数。 双子座95%的间隔包括零,所以这是方向性重现,而不是声称每个骨干都有统计解决的差距.

blocks.en: Table 27: Paired three-action recognition-acquisition gap on the same 59 cases per model. The gap interval resamples shared cases and is not a model ranking.

blocks.en: A separate shared 50-case menu control gives the following free/menu/Hindsight accuracies at three actions: DeepSeek 40/52/60%, Gemini 56/58/70%, GLM 40/48/66%, and GPT-5.5 52/60/68%. This subset asks a different interface question from the 59-case paired replication and is not pooled with it. Within the 181-case primary cohort, the three source strata at k = 3 k=3 are AgentClinic MedQA ( N = 98 N=98 ): Foresight 34.7%, Hindsight 80.6%, gap 45.9 points; dermatology ( N = 49 N=49 ): 42.9%, 85.7%, gap 42.9; DiagnosisArena ( N = 34 N=34 ): 14.7%, 35.3%, gap 20.6. These are conditional-on-Fullsight-correct source comparisons; the small DiagnosisArena eligible stratum limits precision.

blocks.en: F.3 EviMed/REFINE bridge
blocks.zh: F.3 埃维米德/雷菲内桥

blocks.en: The external bridge uses 200 cases, 50 each from AgentClinic MedQA, DiagnosisArena, RareArena, and Derm/CRAFT-MD, after source-aware ID, normalized-text-hash, and high-similarity overlap audits against the internal campaign. Doctor, patient/reporter, summarizer, diagnostician, and verifier use DeepSeek V3.2 at temperature zero. The official baseline and REFINE retain their official roles, action space, indexed-fact patient/reporter response rules, stopping rule, and summarizer-diagnostician-verifier loop. A compatibility adapter multiplexes independent cases through a JSON transport envelope; it changes transport, not case-local visibility. The global 103-target result-blind menu is an additional interface control. The Hindsight path remains a retrospective, non-interactive reference.
blocks.zh: 外部桥梁使用200个病例,每个病例50个来自Clinic MedQA、DisagnosisArena、Rarearena和Derm/CRAFT-MD,先是源头识别ID、正版文本-hash,以及针对内部活动的高度相似性重叠审计。 医生,病人/报告者,总结者,诊断者,以及核查者在0温下使用DeepSeek V3.2. 官方基线和REFINE保留了他们的官方角色,动作空间,有索引的-事实患者/记者反应规则,停止规则,以及总结-诊断者-验证者循环. 一个兼容适配器多轴通过一个JSON运输信封独立大小写;它改变运输,而不是大小写本地能见度. 全球103-目标结果盲菜单是额外的界面控制. 后视道仍是回溯性,非互动性的参考.

blocks.en: Table 28: EviMed at the official 16-turn budget, N = 200 N=200 per strategy. ICR is indexed-reference information coverage; diagnostic accuracy is independently graded; facts are mean unique realized items. The Hindsight row is retrospective and acquires more facts.
blocks.zh: 表28:官方16个回合预算的EviMed,N=200 N=200 ICR是索引参考信息覆盖面;诊断精度独立分级;事实是指唯一实现的项目. 后相克行有追溯性,并获得更多的事实.

blocks.en: Table 29: EviMed prefix endpoints. The rows at 3 and 6 turns are descriptive; the official evaluation budget is 16 turns. ICR and accuracy entries are percentages.
blocks.zh: 表29: EviMed的前缀终点. 3道和6道的行是描述性的;官方的评价预算是16道. 国际民事登记和准确性条目为百分比。

blocks.en: At 16 turns, REFINE exceeds the official free-form baseline by 17.9 ICR points (46.2% versus 28.3%) and 14.5 accuracy points (38.0% versus 23.5%). REFINE also obtains 9.48 versus 5.74 unique facts on average. The comparison therefore establishes that a stronger prospective workflow can improve realized coverage and diagnosis, but it is not an equal-evidence-quantity mechanism test. At the same budget, the menu obtains 6.49 facts and 35.0% accuracy; the retrospective Hindsight reference obtains 14.12 and 53.0%.
blocks.zh: 在16个转弯时,REFINE超过官方的自由式基线17.9个ICR点(46.2%对28.3%)和14.5个精度点(38.0%对23.5%)。 REFINE还平均获得9.48和5.74的独特事实。 因此,比较确定,加强预期工作流程可以改善已实现的覆盖面和诊断,但它不是同等证据-数量机制测试。 在同一预算中,菜单获得6.49个事实和35.0%的准确性;回顾性“光明”参考获得14.12%和53.0%。

blocks.en: F.4 Interpretation of recurrence
blocks.zh: F.4 对复发的解释

blocks.en: The 140-case twelve-action continuation is a fixed subset of the strict 181-case cohort; the 59-case model replication and 200-case external bridge answer separate questions with different budgets and interfaces. Their directional results support recurrence of an acquisition problem. They do not provide a pooled clinical accuracy estimate, show that Hindsight is prospectively attainable, or remove simulator and readout limitations.
blocks.zh: 140个案例的12个动作续作是严格的181个案例组的固定子集;59个案例模式的复制和200个案例的外接桥解答不同预算和接口的单独问题. 它们的方向性结果支持重新出现采购问题。 它们没有提供综合的临床准确性估计,表明Hindsight有可能实现,或消除模拟和读取限制。

blocks.en: G.1 Numerical and protocol checks
blocks.zh: G.1 数字和协议核对

blocks.en: The analyses retain case identifiers across eligibility, evidence acquisition, diagnostic readouts, and interventions, allowing denominators to be checked at the case, step, and case–interval levels. The primary six-step analyses use 181 eligible cases; the extended action analyses use the fixed 140-case subset; the diagnostic-menu comparison uses 120 cases; and the complete rank-by-timing intervention grid uses 33 cases. The corresponding all-eligible rank-by-timing analysis has varying denominators and is reported separately as a sensitivity analysis. Bootstrap resampling is clustered by case when a case contributes multiple observations. The reported figures and tables were checked against their stated cohorts, estimands, and uncertainty calculations.
blocks.zh: 这些分析保留了资格、证据获取、诊断读取和干预等各种案例识别特征,允许在案例、步骤和案例间隙各级检查分母。 初级六步分析使用181个合格病例;扩展行动分析使用固定的140个病例子集;诊断-菜单比较使用120个病例;完整的逐级干预网格使用33个病例。 相应的全有资格的分级分析有不同的分母,作为敏感性分析单独报告. 当一个案件提供多种观察时,Bootstrap再取样按具体情况分组。 报告的数字和表格是对照其申报的组群、意向和不确定性的计算进行的。

blocks.en: The broad ten-model screening analysis is a separate, descriptive experiment. Its selector could condition on each model’s own Fullsight diagnosis, whereas the strict primary Hindsight trajectory does not receive the reference diagnosis or a Fullsight answer. The screen and the primary analysis therefore address different questions. Neither the screen nor a Hindsight ranking should be interpreted as an attainable prospective upper bound.
blocks.zh: 广义的十模型筛选分析是一个单独的描述性实验. 其选择者可以以每个模型本身的Fullsight诊断为条件,而严格的初级Hindsight导轨则得不到参考诊断或Fullsight答案. 因此,屏幕和主要分析涉及不同的问题。 屏幕或平视排名都不应被解释为可以实现的上行界限。

blocks.en: G.2 Protocol dates, execution, and deviations
blocks.zh: G.2 议定书的日期、执行和偏离

blocks.en: The primary six-step protocol was frozen on 2026-09-17; its case-bootstrap seed is 20260917. The 114-case single-fact rescue was frozen on 2026-09-19, before S1/S2 outcomes, with seed 20260920 and 10,000 case-bootstrap draws. The D2 rank-by-timing grid and same-batch D1 readout are separate later analyses; D2 uses seed 20260924, 10,000 case-cluster bootstrap draws, 200,000 sign-flip permutations for prespecified contrasts, and Holm correction over its three confirmatory contrasts. The D1 current-batch readout uses seed 20260924 and 10,000 case-bootstrap draws. Provider calls were routed through OpenRouter with temperature zero, but a provider seed was unavailable, so exact replay of model outputs is not guaranteed even with frozen prompts. Request and response checksums support run-level consistency checks rather than deterministic replay.
blocks.zh: 2026-09-17被冻结了主要六步协议;其箱型袋状种子为20260917. 114箱单发救援于2026-09-19被冻结,在S1/S2结果出炉前,有种子20260920和一万个箱-箱拖图. D2分级网格和同批D1读出是后期的单独分析;D2使用20260924种子,一万个案例集群的靴子图纸,20万个标志-平滑相通来进行预测对比,而Holm则对其三个确认对比进行校正. D1当前批次的读取使用20260924种子和一万个箱-bootstrap绘图. 提供商的电话通过OpenRouter以零温度的路由,但是没有供应商的种子,因此即使有被冻结的提示,也不能保证对模型输出进行精确的重播。 请求和响应校验和支持运行级别的一致性检查,而不是确定重放.

blocks.en: The earlier D1 bridge failed and was not merged with the later measurement batch. D1’s deterministic simplex projection was frozen before completing the full collection. D2’s balanced complete-grid analysis was fixed before intervention outcomes and is distinct from its changing-denominator all-eligible sensitivity. Two S1 rescue outputs required transport salvage and are covered by a worst-case bound. The broad ten-model screen and its later retest are different requests: 0.0% of joined records are the same request, and 9.1% flip correctness. Accordingly, the broad screen is descriptive breadth and does not share the strict primary estimand.
blocks.zh: 更早的D1大桥失败了,没有与后期的测量批次合并. D1的定型简单x投影在完成全集前被冻结. D2的平衡的全网分析在干预结果之前就固定下来了,与它不断变化的分解器完全合格的敏感性是不同的。 两项S1救援产出需要运输救活,并受到最坏情况的约束。 宽大的十模式屏幕及其后期的再测试是不同的要求: 合并记录的0.0%是同一请求,翻转正确度为9.1%. 因此,宽屏是描述性宽度的,并不具有严格的主要意图。

blocks.en: G.3 Manual clinical audit
blocks.zh: G.3 人工临床审计

blocks.en: All clinical-audit judgments reported here were made by human reviewers. The audit covers 100 unique cases and 150 manual review records; 50 cases have two review records. The case-bootstrap intervals in Table 30 describe uncertainty over the sampled cases. Table 31 reports agreement between the two manual review records for the 50 doubly assessed cases.
blocks.zh: 这里报道的所有临床审计判决都是由人类审查员作出的. 审计涉及100个特有案件和150个人工复核记录;50个案件有2个复核记录。 表30中的案件间隔说明了抽样案例的不确定性。 表31. 关于50起双倍评估案件,两个人工审查记录之间的协议。

blocks.zh: 表30:人工临床审核结果. 信心间隔重现病例.

blocks.en: Table 31: Agreement between two manual review records on 50 doubly assessed cases. Chance-adjusted and continuous-rating measures are reported alongside exact agreement where applicable.
blocks.zh: 表31:关于50起双倍评估案件的人工审查记录之间达成一致。 在酌情达成确切协议的同时,还报告经过调整和连续评级的措施。

blocks.en: At least one judgment differs between the two review records for 38 of the 50 doubly assessed cases. Exact agreement and chance-adjusted agreement should therefore be interpreted together, especially for low-prevalence binary judgments. This sampled manual audit informs the interpretation of the selector and evidence rankings; it does not measure outcomes in prospective patient care.
blocks.zh: 在50起重复评估的案件中,至少有一起判决在两个复审记录之间有差异。 因此,精确协议和机会调整协议应一并解释,特别是对于低流行率的二进制判断。 这一抽样人工审计为选择者的解释和证据排名提供了信息;它不衡量未来病人护理的结果。

blocks.en: G.4 Limits of the estimand
blocks.zh: G.4 估计的限度

blocks.en: The 181-case primary cohort is selected from 320 initial cases for Fullsight correctness, protocol completeness, and at least six non-initial facts. It measures what happens on cases the model could solve with a complete case; it is not an unconditional clinical accuracy estimate. Hindsight sees all realized facts before ranking, although the reference diagnosis is withheld; it can infer a likely diagnosis from those facts. Matching the number of acquired facts does not equalize fact identity, diagnostic value, or information available at the time of prospective choice. The deterministic lexical/type matcher can return a clinically coarse or mismatched canonical fact, as the case studies show. Simulated patient and reporter responses are not bedside encounters. Cohort-scale diagnosis-equivalence scoring uses model-assisted semantic grading; the sampled clinical audit described above was performed manually.
blocks.zh: 181个案例的初级组是从320个初始案例中选出的,其内容是完全正确、协议完整以及至少六个非初始事实。 它测量模型用完整的病例可以解决的病例发生的情况;它不是无条件的临床准确性估计。 " 后视 " 在排行前会看到所有已实现的事实,虽然参考诊断被扣;它可以从这些事实中推断出一种可能的诊断。 匹配获得的事实数量并不等于事实身份、诊断值或未来选择时可获得的信息。 如案例研究所显示,确定性词汇/类型匹配者可以返回临床上粗糙或不匹配的犬科事实。 模拟病人和记者的反应不是床边相遇. 协同尺度诊断-等分分法使用模型辅助语义分级法;上述抽样临床审计是人工进行的.

blocks.en: The fixed-support probability vector depends on candidate support, prompt, provider batch, and repeated-call variability. Entropy reduction can accompany movement away from the reference diagnosis; truth-directed gain depends on probability-floor choices. Clinical vignettes illustrate individual behavior but cannot establish prevalence or causality by themselves. The rank-by-timing and one-fact rescue interventions test diagnostic response once a fact is supplied; they do not show that a prospective system can find and obtain that fact. The work should not be used as evidence for autonomous patient care without prospective safety, calibration, fairness, privacy, and clinician-oversight evaluation.
blocks.zh: 固定支持概率向量取决于候选支持,即时,提供者批次,以及重复调用可变性. 增减可以伴随远离参考诊断;真理导向的收益取决于概率-底数选择. 临床维涅特说明个人行为,但不能自己确定流行率或因果关系. 一旦提供了事实,逐级和一次性救援干预就测试诊断反应;它们没有表明一个潜在的系统能够发现和获得这一事实。 在没有预期的安全性、校准、公平性、隐私和临床医生监督评价的情况下,不得将这项工作作为病人自主护理的证据。
